_comment: Per-cycle settings. This is the file the CFACC/board edits every cycle -- unit_classification.json rarely changes, this one does. Matches the 639 CAOC Campaign Intent / TTP 1-1 Key Task structure.

5.name: Assist front-line units (CAS/TST) -- continuous, no target tier, excluded from JIPTL ranking

default_grade_by_tier._comment: Starting-point priority grade (TTP 1-1 Annex E / OPAR SPINS 5.3) by value tier, before human review. The AOC board should re-grade individual JIPTL lines, this just seeds a reasonable default so the list isn't un-graded.

battle_management_area._comment: Center + radius circle is simplest; set shape to 'polygon' and fill 'polygon' (list of [lat, lon] pairs, decimal degrees) instead if the BMA isn't roughly circular.
